Latin word

parum

indeclinable noun and adverb; as a noun with a genitive

too little, not enough

In this lexicon

    the recommended word · classical · Aug. Conf. 10.31.44: dēlectātiōnī parum est; Cic. Brut. 240: leporis parum (Lewis & Short)

    modern
